title: fix(ui): lay the stage path and kanban lanes out by the declared option kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQFYwXjGdbCRo4TV4yeyKWa)_

Fixes #26612

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:阶段条(record:path)和看板现在按选项声明的生命周期 `kind`(open/won/lost)排布。字段一旦声明了 kind,阶段条不再按 `closed_won`/`closed_lost` 拼写猜,未声明 kind 的选项按 spec 读作 open;阶段按 kind 排:open 步骤在前,won 终点收尾,lost 单独放在右侧分组。看板从选项派生的列按 open → won → lost 排,lost 列默认折叠,只显示列名和卡片数,可点开。
- **为什么改**:lost 选项写在列表中间时,阶段条把它后面的步骤和 won 终点全部挤进 lost 分组;看板完全不读 kind,lost 列夹在进行中的列之间。分诊(6440222656)要求声明 kind 后不再保留按名字猜的回退。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改两个渲染器,无新键、无公开导出变化。没声明 kind 的字段,阶段条照旧按拼写猜、照旧按位置排,只多一条开发构建下的 console 警告;看板对没声明 kind 的字段和作者显式写的 `columns` 完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx` 的 `classify` / `placed` / `stageTerminals` 三段;`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/kanbanLaneLifecycle.ts`;两个新测试文件。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.declaredKindLayout-26612.test.tsx packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneLifecycle-26612.test.tsx`,预期 13 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`SelectOption.kind` (`open | won | lost`, objectstack#23809) is published, and the spec reads an absent kind as `open`. On `origin/main` (`a76f811e`):

- `record:path` read a declared kind (objectui#12907) but still classified every option WITHOUT one by its spelling, and laid stages out by position: everything from the first lost-class stage on went into the separated group. A lost option authored mid-list pulled the open and won options after it out of the forward path, and the won option there lost its terminus mark.
- The kanban read no kind at all: lanes derived from the lane field's options ran in authored order, all expanded.
- Nothing warned when the spelling fallback decided a stage.

Now:

**`record:path`** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`)

- Once the status field declares a kind on any option, `classify` reads only the stage's explicit `terminal` and the declared kind; an option without a kind reads as `open`. ⛔ No name-based fallback once a kind is declared (triage 6440222656).
- With declared kinds the stages are laid out by kind, a stable partition: open steps in authored order, then the won option(s) as the forward terminus, then the lost option(s) in the separated group. Both rows (desktop and mobile) index the one laid-out array, as before.
- Every declared won option is a terminus. The last-forward-stage restriction stays for the spelling guess only, where it guards `完成` mid-path.
- A field that declares no kind keeps the spelling fallback and its positional layout unchanged. A dev build (`NODE_ENV !== 'production'`, the package's established guard spelling) warns once per object, field and guessed set, naming the object, the field and the guessed stage values, and saying to declare `kind`. Nothing warns when the fallback guessed nothing.

**Kanban** (`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`, new module-internal `kanbanLaneLifecycle.ts`)

- Lanes derived from the lane field's options go through `lanesFromOptions`: when any option declares a kind, they run open → won → lost (stable, authored order within each class) and every lost lane carries `collapsed: true`, so `KanbanImpl` draws it as a spine with its count and a disclosure the viewer can open (`KanbanColumn.collapsed`, honoured since objectui#9628).
- The kind is read off the raw options by value, so the i18n hop cannot drop it.
- Authored `columns`, data-derived lanes and fields with no declared kind are untouched; the board guesses nothing from spelling.

No new key, prop or export: `lanesFromOptions` is not re-exported from the package entry, and the helper `declaredStageKinds` in `synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` is reused unchanged. `ui/packages/app-shell` needed no change: the kanban reads the object definition through `useSettledSchema` and the path through the record context's `objectSchema`, both unnormalised, so `kind` reaches both readers.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.declaredKindLayout-26612.test.tsx` (7 tests): (a) a lost option authored mid-list sits apart with the open steps and won terminus forward, progress follows the laid-out order, and a lost record marks the lost stage current; (b) an option without a kind on a field that declares kinds reads as open though spelled `closed_lost`; (c) two declared won options are both termini; (d) the fallback warns once naming field and object, re-render does not repeat it, a declaring field never warns, and a fallback that guessed nothing does not warn.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneLifecycle-26612.test.tsx` (6 tests): `lanesFromOptions` order and collapse, no-kind control; the rendered board's lane order; the lost lane collapsed with its count, opening on click; open and won lanes carry no disclosure; CONTROL authored `columns` keep their order and state.
- The existing record-path suites (objectui#12907 declared-kind pins and the spelling-fallback controls included) pass unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, not kept; each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

The tests import the renderers from source (`../../index`, `./kanbanLaneLifecycle`), so no `dist/` sits between mutation and run.

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `if (declaredKinds) return …` → only for options that declare one (the old per-option gate) | Tests 1 failed / 6 passed: (b) |
| A2 | `placed = declaredKinds ? sort : classified` → never sort | 3 failed / 4 passed: (a) ×2, (c) |
| A3 | every declared won → last-forward-stage only | 1 failed / 6 passed: (c) |
| A4 | the warning effect always returns early | 1 failed / 6 passed: (d) first case. A first attempt appended to the anchor line and was refused by the tool as a no-op (anchor count 1 → 1); rerun with a distinct replacement. |
| A5 | `lanesFromOptions` ignores kinds | 3 failed / 3 passed in the kanban file |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **A lost record's path.** The card asks that a record in a lost state show "the path stopped at its last open step". The record carries only its current value, not the open step it left, so this PR draws what is known: the lost stage current, with ✗, apart from the rail, and the forward steps untravelled (unchanged from main). Drawing the last open step needs a stage-history read; reported to the seat as an open question, not built here.
- **Screenshots** of a HotCRM lead (未通过) and opportunity (Closed Lost) at 1280 px are not taken: HotCRM declares its kinds in its own card, and this container runs no HotCRM. The DOM pins above assert the same layout through `data-stage-terminal`, `data-stage-state` and the two desktop groups.
- **Lane paging.** The paged-lane key (`pagedLaneIdsKey`) still lists the option values in authored order; it keys the per-lane fetch, not the layout, so the order there does not matter.
- `#26581` (same seat) also edits `record-path.tsx` and rebases after this lands.
